The '''Gilneas Memorial Stone''' is a monument located in the center of [[Ravenshire]], in [[Gilneas]]. 

==Contents==
{{Book||height=30em|align=left|content=
We stand here today to honor their sacrifice, to remember their selflessness, their unwavering determination, and their unyielding spirit that embodied the very essence of Gilneas.

Their devotion to their country and their fellow citizens was unparalleled. Their sacrifice, however, was not in vain, for Gilneas is now stronger than ever before. These brave soldiers have left a lasting legacy, one that will continue to inspire and guide us as we move forward.

We must remain steadfast in our resolve to rebuild and move forward. We have proven that we are resilient, and our will is iron. Gilneas will endure.

I am grateful for the trust you have placed in me during these challenging times.

Your King - [[Genn Greymane|Genn]]
}}

==Speculation==
Presumably, as this memorial was written within Genn's lifetime, it is dedicated to Gilnean soldiers lost either during the [[Second War]] or in the Scourge attack by [[Naze the Eternal]] that saw the destruction of [[Ruins of Greyshire|Greyshire]].
